shortDescription: Mexico's finance minister Edgar Amador said on Wednesday that the country is on track to achieve its year-end deficit targets for this fiscal year of 4.1% and 3.9% for 2027.Mexico's finance ministry sees a baseline economic growth scenario of 1.4% in 2026.

Mexico's finance ministry sees a baseline economic growth scenario of 1.4% in 2026.
